TA0064.title: Dark Web Marketplace Operator
TA0064.description: Organizations or individuals operating underground dark web trading marketplaces, providing Crime-as-a-Service (CaaS) infrastructure. These platforms host and facilitate trading of illegal goods and services, including stolen data, malware and exploit tools, attack services (DDoS-for-hire, RaaS), forged documents, and banking card kits. Platforms achieve anonymous transactions through cryptocurrency payments and mixing services, using Tor or I2P networks to conceal infrastructure.

references.title: Europol Internet Organised Crime Threat Assessment (IOCTA)
